title: Gardner Minshew: All you really have is the opportunity to work and get better

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Gardner Minshew: All you really have is the opportunity to work and get better
sources.description: Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett's ongoing absence from the team's offseason program has opened the door for others to get more work as the team prepares for the 2026 season.
